config.immersive_map.title: Immersive Map
config.immersive_map.playerMarker.head: Head
config.immersive_map.option.startInOffHa: Take the map out in the off hand
M puts the map straight into the off hand.
config.immersive_map.option.hotbarMovesM: Hotbar keys move map to off hand
Switching hotbar slots with the map in both hands moves it to the off hand instead of putting it away.
config.immersive_map.option.showHeldSlot: Map slot next to the hotbar
Shows an off-hand style slot with the map while it is in your hands.
config.immersive_map.option.thirdPersonP: Players holding the map raise their arms and hold a real map sheet. Other players need the mod on the server.
config.immersive_map.option.followPlayer: The map stays centered on you. Press N to pin it in place.
config.immersive_map.option.zoomAroundCu: Zooming keeps the point under the cursor in place.
config.immersive_map.option.worldLightin: Like vanilla, the map gets darker in the dark. Turn off for a always-bright map.
config.immersive_map.option.cursorSensit: Map pixels per mouse pixel while holding right click.
config.immersive_map.option.cursorHideSe: The cursor fades out when you have not moved it for this long.
How close to the edge (in map pixels) the cursor must be to scroll the map.
config.immersive_map.option.smoothArrowR: Vanilla turns the arrow in 16 steps.
config.immersive_map.option.showOtherPla: Other players are shown as their heads.
config.immersive_map.option.showMobs.too: Loaded mobs as the heads of their models, only those on the level the map shows.
config.immersive_map.option.alwaysShowMa: Off: a marker's name appears in a tooltip when the cursor is on it.
config.immersive_map.option.showDeathMar: A red X where you last died. Click it in map mode to remove it.
config.immersive_map.option.showChunkGri: Faint chunk borders at zoom 1:1 to 1:4.
config.immersive_map.option.showCoordina: Your coordinates (or the cursor's) on the bottom left of the map border.
config.immersive_map.option.scanBudgetMs: How much time per tick the map may spend reading chunks. Lower = smoother, higher = faster filling.
config.immersive_map.option.smartCaveLay: Underground, and on every level of the Nether, the map is a slice at your height that only shows floors and walls you have actually seen.
config.immersive_map.option.autoCaveLaye: Switch to the cave map underground
Page Up/Down, or Shift+wheel while holding right mouse, choose a layer manually, Home returns to automatic. The Nether always uses levels.
config.immersive_map.option.caveViewDist: How far, in blocks, floors and walls in your line of sight are mapped. Nearest areas fill first.
config.immersive_map.option.markerPanelO: Choose icons and write names right on the held map with the map cursor (hold right mouse) instead of a screen. While the name is being written the keyboard types into it, like the chat: Enter places, Esc closes.
config.immersive_map.option.mapSync.tool: Needs the mod on the server. Explored areas of everyone with this enabled are merged.
config.immersive_map.option.showCursorBi: Writes the biome name on the map border.
